answer_1.quote: In this work, we focus on the generative QA setting where a model needs to generate a textual answer rather than extract it.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate performance on the ASQA task along the following two aspects. ROUGE ... Disambiguation Metrics ... DR Score.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a small-scale human study involving a subset of models... Pairwise Comparisons ... we ask annotators to choose the better answer in terms of each of the three criteria: Comprehensiveness (COMP), Fluency (FLUE), and Human Overall impression (HO).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators compare two long-form answers and rate them on comprehensiveness, fluency, and overall impression.
